glance.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang returned to company headquarters following his reinstatement as CEO.
Anthropic launched Claude Ship to review, fix, and approve code changes automatically.
Sierra raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round, doubling its valuation to $30 billion.
Standard Bank Group automated generative AI risk assessments using Amazon Bedrock in its AWS account.

big_pour.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship for code approvals
big_pour.summary: Anthropic released Claude Ship, a set of developer tools. It allows AI agents to review, fix, and approve routine AI-generated code changes.
big_pour.why: Routine code review bottlenecks can now be handled directly by AI agents.

explain.kid: Anthropic made AI tools called Claude Ship that can check, fix, and approve code changes all by themselves.
explain.pm: Anthropic launched Claude Ship to clear developer bottlenecks by letting AI agents automatically review, fix, and approve routine code changes.
explain.engineer: Claude Ship introduces AI agents designed to review, fix, and approve routine pull requests and AI-generated code changes directly.

big_pour.headline: Amazon acquires Decart's AI optimization technology
big_pour.summary: Amazon is acquiring Decart's AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal as it prepares to sell Trainium chips.

big_pour.headline: Sierra doubles valuation to $30 billion
big_pour.teaser: Demand for AI customer experience surges
big_pour.summary: Enterprise customer experience company Sierra raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round. Co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, Sierra doubled its valuation to $30 billion.

office_blend.headline: Standard Bank Group automates AI risk assessments
office_blend.summary: Standard Bank Group automated evidence for its generative AI approval gates. Working with AWS Professional Services, the bank uses LLM-as-a-judge on Amazon Bedrock to score use cases against policies and standards.

office_blend.headline: Hyring Insight platform sees tenfold revenue growth
office_blend.summary: Hyring announced that its workforce intelligence platform, Hyring Insight, grew tenfold in revenue over 90 days. The AI hiring platform relies on transparency and its Ask AI feature.

still_roasting.summary: Nothing CEO Carl Pei demonstrated the upcoming Ear Note earbuds and charging case that record and transcribe conversations.
SAP detailed its upcoming Autonomous Enterprise concept featuring AI agents that act automatically within the SAP system.

quick_sips.summary: Google Search's AI Mode can now access Drive and Wallet to provide users with more personalized responses.
SpaceX was sued by Oregon and Virginia over state consumer protection violations involving Grok AI features.
Asus released the ProArt P16 laptop, costing up to $7,000, which can run multiple local AI agents.

stories.label: Open source tool
stories.headline: Google DeepMind open-sources quantum algorithm verification framework
stories.summary: Google DeepMind open-sourced the Lean 4 framework used to verify quantum algorithms developed by Gemini 4 agents, which cut quantum computing costs 290-fold.

stories.label: Open models
stories.headline: AWS launches open decision models for AI agents
stories.summary: AWS launched Strands Decider v2, a family of five open decision models designed for AI agents.

concept.explanation: An architecture introduced in Z.ai's GLM-5.4 model that executes the same 28 layers multiple times to increase computational capacity.

long_read.headline: Management consulting is not a thin wrapper on intelligence
long_read.summary: Management consulting serves as a test case for AI's impact on knowledge work.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.
